# Design by Baxit

> Studio of Abdul Basit, a web developer with 8+ years building sites on
> Elementor/WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, and Wix. Serves international
> clients, mainly in the United States. Three lines of work: web development,
> graphic design, and small-business automation. Complete packages can run
> from a logo, through a website, to a simple automation. Quotes are agreed
> on WhatsApp. Tagline on the site is descriptive: websites, design, and
> automation. The studio is based in Pakistan (PKT), with flexible hours so
> meetings can overlap US time zones.

Spelling is Design by Baxit (B-A-X-I-T). The founder's name is Abdul Basit.

## Services

- Web development — landing pages, business sites, Shopify and online stores, WordPress and Elementor, Squarespace, Wix, redesigns.
- Graphic design — logo, brand kit, social media templates, marketing graphics.
- Small-business automation — lead forms to email or a sheet, booking links, WhatsApp Business setup, simple no-code automations.

## Starting prices (USD, suggestions pending Abdul's confirmation)

Shown on the site as "Starting at". Final scope and price are confirmed on WhatsApp before work begins.

- Starter — starting at $1,500. About a five-page site on WordPress/Elementor, Squarespace, or Wix.
- Business — starting at $3,500. Logo, simple brand kit, a larger site or small Shopify store, social templates, lead form.
- Complete Launch — starting at $6,500. Logo through website through automation (lead sheet, booking link, WhatsApp Business, one simple no-code automation).

Add-ons are listed on the home page, also as starting prices.
